title: Interactive lesson
emptyLesson: This lesson has nothing in it to work through yet.

answers.label: Answer
answers.none: This question has no set answer.

resume.title: Picked up where you left off
resume.body: Your answers from last time are still here, kept on this device. Carry on, or start the lesson again from the beginning.

quit.title: Leave the lesson?
quit.body: Your answers are kept on this device, so you can open the lesson again and carry on from here.
quit.noStorageBody: This browser won’t let us keep your answers, so there’s nothing to come back to. Leaving now discards what you’ve typed.

summary.readThrough: You worked through the whole lesson.
summary.notConfigured: The lesson hub is not configured, so your answers can’t be saved.
summary.signInToSave: Sign in before you start to have your answers saved privately to your account.
summary.signedInSince: A different account signed in while you were working, so these answers aren’t filed to it. They’re still on this device, kept for whoever started this run-through.

saved.heading: Your answers
saved.privateNote: Only you can see these. The lesson’s author can’t.
